title: Ascent guidance plan
description: Guidance plan for the two-stage launch vehicle defined in README.md. The plan commands a launch azimuth, a time-referenced piecewise-linear pitch program, and an upper-stage burn/coast schedule. All times are seconds since liftoff (t=0).

launch_azimuth_deg.description: Launch azimuth in degrees from north, positive toward east, in [0, 360). Defines the inertially-fixed launch-direction unit vector uL = cos(A)*Nhat + sin(A)*Ehat of the site-local basis at t=0.

times_s.description: Strictly increasing knot times since liftoff; times_s[0] must be 0.

pitch_deg.description: Pitch at each knot: angle of thrust above the local horizon about the inertially-fixed launch direction. Same length as times_s. Piecewise-linear between knots, hold last value after the final knot.

upper_stage_schedule.description: Sequential burn/coast entries for the restartable upper stage, starting at t = t_burn1 + separation_delay_s. Total duration at most 3000 s.

duration_s.description: Segment duration in seconds. A burn segment ends at min(duration_s, propellant exhaustion); after exhaustion the remainder of the segment is a coast.
